architecture.marketState: m0=dropout(epoch,GNGLU(normalize(feature[t]),W)); keep(epoch)=0.2*5^(min(epoch,256)/256); dropout(epoch)=1-keep(epoch), then 0 after epoch 256; one dense shared block emits the single next-active-return density
architecture.conditionalReturns: T_0=row-softmax(P_0 R_0/sqrt(Q)); J_0=q_0[:,None] times T_0; p_0=sum_D(J_0)
architecture.pathTransition: The shared dense recurrent cell is retained from the H15 architecture but the supervised H1 rollout consumes only its first emission
architecture.matrixApproximation: none; every GNGLU uses dense matrices at expected hidden width floor((input+output)/2)
architecture.outputPoints: ordered market-conditioned unit-interval knots initialized from the fixed global 32-knot grid

density.targetFilter: each start and the single target are exact-nonzero active returns
